interface.longDescription: A central AMSoft plugin for reviewed agentic workflows. It bundles provenance-backed software delivery; transparent non-systematic and auditable systematic literature reviews; protected YouTube media workflows; truthful restaurant marketing; business, writing, WordPress operations, and opt-in Stream audit logging; preservation-first and reference-object prompt guidance for OpenAI food-image edits; protected cloud and Excalidraw operations; and authenticated-encrypted configuration transfer.
